title: Jade Dynasty Season 4 Final Season Episode 10 Indonesia, English Sub
description:
English

After taking on the identity of Gui Li, Zhang Xiaofan faces the final battle that will determine the fate of the cultivation world. To stop the threat of the Beast God, he journeys to the Ancient Demon-Suppressing Cave, where he joins forces with Lu Xueqi to confront an overwhelmingly powerful enemy.

At the same time, the conflict between the Ghost King, the Qingyun Sect, and the major cultivation factions reaches its peak. Long-hidden secrets begin to surface, great sacrifices become inevitable, and the final war decides the future of the world.

In the end, Zhang Xiaofan must choose between love, friendship, and his own convictions in the climactic conclusion to the adaptation of the novel Zhu Xian.

Indonesia
Setelah mengambil identitas Gui Li, Zhang Xiaofan menghadapi pertempuran terakhir yang menentukan nasib dunia kultivasi. Demi menghentikan ancaman Beast God, ia menuju Ancient Demon-Suppressing Cave, tempat ia bekerja sama dengan Lu Xueqi untuk menghadapi musuh yang sangat kuat.
Di saat yang sama, konflik antara Ghost King, Sekte Qingyun, dan berbagai kekuatan besar mencapai puncaknya. Rahasia lama mulai terungkap, pengorbanan besar tak terhindarkan, dan perang terakhir menentukan masa depan dunia. Zhang Xiaofan akhirnya harus memilih antara cinta, persahabatan, dan keyakinannya sendiri, dalam klimaks yang menutup kisah adaptasi novel Zhu Xian.
